<style>
:root{
  --ink:#14120e; --ink-2:#2a2620; --paper:#f4efe6; --paper-2:#ebe4d7; --line:rgba(20,18,14,.14);
  --gold:#b8915a; --gold-lt:#d9bb88; --muted:#5f574b;
  --gem:#b8915a; --gem-deep:#1c1913; --gem-soft:#d9bb88; --gem-name:"Aranyhegy";
  --serif:"Libre Caslon Text", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --sans:"Jost", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1);
  --pad:clamp(20px,5vw,72px);
}
body[data-gem="smaragd"]{ --gem:#2f7a5f; --gem-deep:#0d2620; --gem-soft:#cfae6c; }
body[data-gem="zafir"]{ --gem:#3a62a8; --gem-deep:#0c1830; --gem-soft:#a9c0e6; }
body[data-gem="haz"]{ --gem:#b8915a; --gem-deep:#1c1913; --gem-soft:#d9bb88; }

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:84px}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 18px/1.6 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gem);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
.skip{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);padding:12px 16px;z-index:100;text-decoration:none}
.skip:focus{top:12px}
.vh{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.012em;line-height:1.1;margin:0}
h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5.4vw,76px)}
h3{font-size:clamp(26px,2.4vw,34px);font-weight:400}
em{font-style:italic;font-weight:300}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
.eyebrow{font:600 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 26px}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:34px;height:1px;background:currentColor;opacity:.6}
.wrap{max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 var(--pad)}
section{position:relative}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;font:600 15px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.02em;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s,transform .3s var(--ease)}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold-lt);color:var(--ink)}
.btn-gold:hover{background:#e7cc9e}
.btn-dark{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.btn-dark:hover{background:var(--ink-2)}
.btn-line{border-color:currentColor;background:transparent}
.btn-line:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.btn svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}

/* header */
.hdr{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:50;color:#fff;transition:background .4s,color .4s,box-shadow .4s}
.hdr .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:80px;gap:24px}
.hdr.solid{background:rgba(244,239,230,.94);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line);backdrop-filter:saturate(1.2) blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(1.2) blur(10px)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;min-height:44px}
.brand-img{height:40px;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.hdr.solid .brand-img{filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1))}

.brand-img{height:40px;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.brand-img ~ span{display:none}
.hdr.solid .brand-img{filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.1))}
@media(max-width:640px){.brand-img{height:34px}}
.brand b{font:400 21px/1 var(--serif);letter-spacing:.01em}
.brand small{display:block;font:600 10px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75;margin-top:5px}
.nav{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.nav a{font:500 14px/1 var(--sans);text-decoration:none;padding:15px 12px;opacity:.9;border-radius:6px}
.nav a:hover{opacity:1;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}
.hdr-cta{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.hdr-tel{font:500 14px/1 var(--sans);text-decoration:none;padding:15px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.hdr .btn{min-height:46px;padding:0 20px}
.hdr.solid .btn-gold{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}

/* hero */
.hero{min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#1a1712}
.hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0}
.hero-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 40%;transform:scale(1.04);animation:heroIn 2.4s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes heroIn{to{transform:scale(1)}}
.hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
  linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(12,10,8,.54) 0%,rgba(12,10,8,.22) 26%,rgba(12,10,8,.38) 48%,rgba(12,10,8,.68) 72%,rgba(12,10,8,.76) 100%),
  linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(12,10,8,.52) 0%,rgba(12,10,8,.12) 55%,rgba(12,10,8,0) 75%)}
.hero-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-top:120px;padding-bottom:28px}
.hero-kicker{font:600 12px/1.4 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-lt);margin-bottom:22px;display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.75),0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.hero-kicker span+span::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;margin-right:16px;vertical-align:middle;opacity:.7}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,7.4vw,112px);max-width:12ch;text-shadow:0 2px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.hero h1 em{color:var(--gold-lt);text-shadow:0 2px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.7),0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.hero-sub{font-size:clamp(17px,1.4vw,20px);max-width:44ch;margin:24px 0 0;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.7),0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}

/* booking bar */
.book{position:relative;z-index:3;margin-top:36px;background:rgba(20,18,14,.72);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:18px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1.1fr .8fr 1.25fr auto;align-items:stretch}
.book .f{padding:14px 20px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;min-height:76px}
.book label{font:600 11px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-lt);margin-bottom:8px}
.book input,.book select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:#fff;font:500 17px/1.2 var(--sans);padding:6px 0;min-height:44px;width:100%;color-scheme:dark;cursor:pointer}
.book select option{color:#111}
.book .sel{position:relative}
.book .sel::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:2px;top:50%;width:8px;height:8px;border-right:1.5px solid var(--gold-lt);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--gold-lt);transform:translateY(-70%) rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}
.book .go{padding:12px;display:flex;align-items:center}
.book .go .btn{height:100%;min-height:52px;padding:0 30px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--gold-lt);color:var(--ink);font-size:16px}
.book .go .btn:hover{background:#ecd3a6}
.book-note{grid-column:1/-1;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:12px 20px;font-size:14px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 22px;align-items:center}
.book input::placeholder,.book select::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
.book-note strong{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.book-note .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#7fcf9f;display:inline-block;margin-right:8px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(127,207,159,.18)}
.book-note a{color:var(--gold-lt);text-underline-offset:4px}

/* BOOK BAR v2: light, high-contrast card so it is spotted instantly */
.book{background:#fbf8f2;border:1px solid rgba(184,145,90,.6);box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 var(--gold),0 28px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.55);backdrop-filter:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}
.book .f,.book .go,.book .apt-f,.book-note{border-color:rgba(20,18,14,.12)!important}
.book label{color:#7a5c30}
.book input,.book select{color:var(--ink);color-scheme:light}
.book input::placeholder,.book select::placeholder{color:rgba(20,18,14,.55)}
.book .f:hover{background:rgba(184,145,90,.07)}
.book .f:focus-within{background:rgba(184,145,90,.12);box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold)}
.book .sel::after{border-color:#7a5c30}
.book .go{background:rgba(184,145,90,.10)}
.book .go .btn{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(20,18,14,.55);font-size:17px;padding:0 34px}
.book .go .btn:hover{background:#000;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.book-note{background:var(--paper-2);color:var(--ink);font-size:14.5px}
.book-note strong{color:var(--ink)}
.book-note a{color:#7a5c30}
.book-note .dot{background:#2f9e63;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,158,99,.18)}

.book{max-width:100%;min-width:0}
.book .f,.book .go{min-width:0}
.book input,.book select{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.book .sel select{padding-right:26px}
.book .sel::after{right:14px}
.book label{font-size:13px}
.hero-sub{text-wrap:balance}
@media(max-width:700px){.book{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}.book .f{padding:12px 14px}}

/* trust strip */
.trust{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.trust ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.trust li{padding:30px 26px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:baseline}
.trust li:first-child{border-left:0;padding-left:0}
.trust .n{font:300 40px/1 var(--serif);color:var(--gold-lt)}
.trust .t{font-size:14px;line-height:1.4;color:rgba(244,239,230,.82)}
.trust .t b{display:block;color:var(--paper);font-weight:600;font-size:15px}

/* story */
.story{padding:clamp(90px,12vw,170px) 0}
.story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:clamp(40px,7vw,120px);align-items:center}
.story blockquote{margin:0;font:300 clamp(32px,3.6vw,54px)/1.12 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.story blockquote::before{content:"\201E";display:block;font-size:1.6em;line-height:.6;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:10px}
.story cite{display:block;margin-top:28px;font:600 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;color:var(--muted)}
.story .lead{margin-top:40px;max-width:52ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px}
.story-pics{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5}
.story-pics figure{margin:0;position:absolute;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(20,18,14,.45)}
.story-pics .p1{inset:0 22% 18% 0}
.story-pics .p2{right:0;bottom:0;width:52%;aspect-ratio:3/4;border:10px solid var(--paper)}
.story-pics img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.sig{font:italic 300 15px/1.4 var(--serif);color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px}

/* HOUSE / apartments (signature) */
.house{background:var(--gem-deep);color:#f3eee4;padding:clamp(90px,11vw,150px) 0;transition:background-color 1s var(--ease)}
.house .eyebrow{color:var(--gem-soft)}
.house h2 em{color:var(--gem-soft);transition:color 1s}
.house-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:56px}
.house-head p{color:rgba(243,238,228,.78);max-width:46ch;margin:0}
.house-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(330px,.62fr) 1.38fr;gap:clamp(30px,5vw,80px);align-items:start}
.section-svg{position:sticky;top:110px}
.section-svg svg{width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.section-svg .floor{cursor:pointer;transition:fill .6s,fill-opacity .6s,stroke .6s}
.section-svg .floor-s{fill:#2f7a5f;fill-opacity:.12;stroke:#cfae6c}
.section-svg .floor-z{fill:#3a62a8;fill-opacity:.12;stroke:#a9c0e6}
body[data-gem="smaragd"] .floor-s,body[data-gem="haz"] .floor-s{fill-opacity:.85}
body[data-gem="zafir"] .floor-z,body[data-gem="haz"] .floor-z{fill-opacity:.85}
.section-svg .floor:hover{fill-opacity:.55}
.section-svg text{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;fill:#f3eee4;text-transform:uppercase;pointer-events:none}
.section-svg .lbl{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none}
.section-svg .win{fill:rgba(255,236,190,.0);transition:fill .8s}
body[data-gem="smaragd"] .win-s,body[data-gem="zafir"] .win-z,body[data-gem="haz"] .win{fill:rgba(255,226,160,.85)}
.svg-cap{margin-top:18px;font-size:14px;color:rgba(243,238,228,.7)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:26px 0 0}
.tab{min-height:48px;padding:0 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(243,238,228,.28);background:transparent;color:#f3eee4;font:500 15px/1 var(--sans);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s}
.tab i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}
.tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:#f3eee4;color:var(--ink);border-color:#f3eee4}
.tab:hover{border-color:#f3eee4}
.apt[hidden]{display:none}
.apt{animation:aptIn .7s var(--ease)}
@keyframes aptIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.apt-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}
.apt h3{font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,72px);font-weight:300}
.apt .where{font:600 12px/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gem-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.price{text-align:right}
.price b{display:block;font:300 clamp(30px,3vw,42px)/1 var(--serif)}
.price span{font-size:14px;color:rgba(243,238,228,.75)}
.gal{position:relative}
.track{display:flex;gap:12px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;border-radius:6px;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}
.track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.track figure{margin:0;flex:0 0 100%;scroll-snap-align:start;position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/2;overflow:hidden;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.track img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.track figcaption{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:12px;background:rgba(14,12,10,.7);color:#fff;font-size:13px;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px}
.gal-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.gal-ctl button{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(243,238,228,.3);background:transparent;color:#f3eee4;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
.gal-ctl button:hover{background:rgba(243,238,228,.1)}
.gal-ctl svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.gal-ctl .count{font:500 14px/1 var(--sans);color:rgba(243,238,228,.75);margin-left:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.apt-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px;margin-top:34px}
.apt-body p{color:rgba(243,238,228,.86)}
.feat{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 22px}
.feat li{padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(243,238,228,.14);font-size:15px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:baseline}
.feat li::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;flex:none;transform:rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px);background:var(--gem-soft)}
.apt-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
.apt-cta .btn-gem{background:var(--gem-soft);color:var(--ink)}
.apt-cta .btn-gem:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}



/* VOUCHER v3: centered head + stage */
.voucher{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--paper) 0%,var(--paper-2) 100%)}
.vx-head{max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.vx-head h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.2vw,60px);margin:10px 0 0;text-wrap:balance}
.vx-sub{margin:22px auto 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch;font-size:18px}
.vx-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.35fr) minmax(0,.9fr);gap:clamp(36px,5vw,84px);align-items:center;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
.vx-left{position:relative}
.vx-left::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6% -4% -4% 6%;border-radius:22px;background:rgba(184,145,90,.22);transform:rotate(1.6deg);z-index:0}
.vx-card{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 40px 70px -28px rgba(20,18,14,.45),0 0 0 1px rgba(184,145,90,.45);transform:rotate(-1.2deg);transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.vx-card:hover{transform:rotate(0)}
.vx-card img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.vx-cap{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:30px 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
.vx-cap a{color:var(--ink);text-underline-offset:3px;margin-left:6px}
.vx-right{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);border-radius:20px;padding:clamp(28px,3vw,44px);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(20,18,14,.55)}
.vx-right h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(30px,2.8vw,42px)}
.vx-right h3 em{color:var(--gold-lt)}
.vx-tiers{display:grid;gap:10px;margin:26px 0 0;padding:0;border:0}
.vx-sr{position:absolute;left:-9999px}
.vx-tier{position:relative}
.vx-tier input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;cursor:pointer;z-index:2}
